notes.title: Fakutori's demo gets an overhaul!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004328/d40cb17831377d50725c436e288ce127c40ae226.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Good news, everyone! After months of work and playtesting, I'm happy to announce a new version of the demo![/b][/p][p]This is mostly a technical update: huge chunks of the game's code and systems have been rewritten. The result: increased stability, fewer bugs, and most importantly, a dramatic increase in framerate! Wakas reported up to 10 times the framerate in some cases, which is especially noticeable on very big factories. You know what that means: time to build even bigger factories![/p][p]The content itself is basically the same, but the update also packs a bunch of QoL changes and small reworks that will make your factory building easier. Here's what you can look forward in this new and improved demo:[/p][list][*][p]As I said, the game runs better than ever; huge factories will not impact your framerate as much as they did before, so build away![/p][/*][*][p]The core system of the game, which dictates the way blocks move and interact with each others, has been largely rewritten; interactions between blocks are now much more consistent, logical and predictable.[/p][/*][*][p]New QoL features have been implemented: the save/load menu has been reworked, the currency counters now display big numbers in a more efficient way, you can now resize the game window in windowed mode... Those small points of friction are now a thing of the past![/p][/*][*][p]The wakas have informed me that the Black Hole and Quasar blocks have new properties. I'll let you discover by yourselves what you can now do with them...[/p][/*][*][p]And of course, a truckload of bugs have been fixed. It's a wonder the game ever worked at all.[/p][/*][/list][p]A big thank you to playtesters on Fakutori's Discord, who worked tirelessly to ensure that this new version was functionnal. I couldn't have done it without them! <3[/p][p]And of course, another big thank you to everyone who played and enjoyed the demo! I hope you'll enjoy this new version![/p][p]As for me, I'll keep working on the game to bring you the final version as soon as possible. Happy building![/p]

notes.title: Fakutori has been announced !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004328/0285d46327bfcefd40bb35788bdcdb6262e445e2.jpg[/img]

[b]Fakutori[/b] was announced yesterday during Games Made in France, a french streaming event dedicated to highlight national and regional game makers.

We really enjoyed watching people discover Fakutori, asking questions about its setting and mechanics, and being generally curious about the game.

If you're reading this, you're probably already part of our group of wishlisters, and if you're not : what are you waiting for ? Wishlist away !

Antoine, who is the solo developer behind the game, is working hard to give you the best laid-back automation experience possible and putting out a public demo as soon as possible.

For now stay tuned for more news, and feel free to join [url=https://discord.gg/BpGHvuFYnE]our discord[/url] where we actively answer any questions and where you can apply to join future closed playtests.
Also, check out Antoine's socials [url=https://play-fakutori.com/]on the game's website[/url].

See you next time !
